purpose: Recover persistent live-repository work before new edits and bound non-authoritative analysis storage without deleting ambiguous evidence

skill_independence.rule: Every launch prompt names the readable Factory contract and documentation paths and remains operationally complete when no skill is selected or injected.
skill_independence.on_guidance_path_unavailable: Report the unavailable path and follow the complete inline prompt. Never invent omitted guidance or stop merely because automatic skill loading failed.

recovery_gate.run: at session start, after any reconnect or resume, after a timed-out or interrupted command, and whenever live status changes unexpectedly
recovery_gate.clean_tree_action: record the observed clean state and continue
recovery_gate.dirty_tree_action: finish the recovery review before selecting or editing a new batch

decisions.recoverable-current-work: Adopt it as the first batch: understand the partial intent, finish or narrow it, run the required checks, and checkpoint it before unrelated work.
decisions.unrelated-preexisting-work: Preserve it and exclude it from staging, tests that rewrite it, and overlapping edits.
decisions.generated-ephemeral-output: Remove it only after proving the producer, reproducibility, absence of durable references, and absence of an active process that still owns it.
decisions.unknown-origin-or-intent: Do not delete, reset, overwrite, or stage it. Avoid overlap; if the requested batch cannot be isolated, report a concrete blocker.

recovery_gate.required_record: Record the observed paths, classification, evidence, action, retained unknowns, and post-review status in durable batch evidence or the final handoff.

artifact_classes.session-scratch: Outputs created by the current campaign for an active experiment; normally deleted after compact evidence is retained.
artifact_classes.reproducible-cache: Regenerable outputs keyed by their real inputs; may be removed when no active command needs them.
artifact_classes.durable-analysis-evidence: An exceptional raw artifact with a current binding, a tracked reference, and a reason compact evidence is insufficient.
artifact_classes.shared-provider-state: Operator-managed IDA/Ghidra databases, toolchains, Wine prefixes, or other reusable provider state; not session cleanup scope and preferably stored outside .analysis.
artifact_classes.legacy-unknown: Pre-existing or unmanifested content whose ownership, reproducibility, or references are not established; never automatically removed or trusted.

creation_policy.one_shot_outputs: Use an OS temporary directory with command-local cleanup when the output is not needed after the command.
creation_policy.multi_command_outputs: Reuse one bounded .analysis/gpt-web/<campaign-id>/ scratch root rather than creating a new directory or whole-program export for every query.
creation_policy.budget_rule: Crossing either threshold requires a manifest reason and an explicit checkpoint cleanup disposition; it never authorizes deletion of shared or unknown content.

freshness_rule: An analysis artifact from an earlier HEAD, target, database, tool version, or command input is only a lead until its binding is checked or the observation is reproduced. Cleanup classification never grants evidence authority.
